title: Hydrothermal synthesis, structure, and properties of two new nanosized Ln26 (Ln = Ho, Er) clusters

synthesis.procedure: Ho2O3, Mn(OAc)2·4H2O, isonicotinic acid (HIN), formic acid, and water were mixed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave. The solution was adjusted to pH 2.0 with 36% HCl, stirred for 12 h, sealed, and heated at 170 °C for 7 days. Light-yellow block crystals were obtained.

reagents.name: manganese(II) acetate tetrahydrate
reagents.role: reagent; Mn is not incorporated in the product

synthesis.time: 12 h stirring, followed by 7 days heating
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Hydrothermal synthesis in a sealed 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Light-yellow block crystals obtained; further work-up not reported.

properties.summary: Solid-state blue fluorescence at room temperature, with an emission maximum at 432.6 nm upon excitation near 216 nm.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for Ho26, 853867

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete Ho26 core comprises five cubane-like Ho4 hydroxo units and six additional Ho ions, reinforced by coordinated carbonates around an encapsulated, uncoordinated carbonate. Isonicotinate, acetate, and water complete its coordination sphere. Hydrogen bonding assembles four clusters into a unit, then into layers and a three-dimensional supramolecular framework; these links do not make the coordination cluster polymeric.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure for 1, replacing Ho2O3 with Er2O3. Er2O3, Mn(OAc)2·4H2O, isonicotinic acid, formic acid, and water were mixed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave. The solution was adjusted to pH 2.0 with 36% HCl, stirred for 12 h, sealed, and heated at 170 °C for 7 days. Light-pink block crystals were obtained.

reagents.name: manganese(II) acetate tetrahydrate
reagents.role: reagent in the shared procedure; Mn is not incorporated in the reported formula

synthesis.time: 12 h stirring, followed by 7 days heating
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Hydrothermal synthesis in a sealed 25 mL Teflon-lined autoclave
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Light-pink block crystals obtained; further work-up not reported.

properties.summary: Solid-state fluorescence at room temperature, with an emission maximum at 433.2 nm upon excitation near 216 nm; the article describes its emission as slightly stronger than that of 1.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for Er26, 853866

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An isostructural Er26 analogue of 1 with one additional isonicotinate and one fewer acetate ligand. Its discrete carbonate-containing cluster participates in a hydrogen-bonded three-dimensional supramolecular framework; all Er ions in its Er4 hydroxo building units are reported as eight-coordinate.
